method: Ordinary task-feedback-triggered invocation of the existing supplied calibration procedure.
scope: Two fresh native runs on the same four development worlds; 24 episodes, four unique worlds. Fresh unseeded native instrument noise per episode; no paired-noise or cross-domain claim.
researcher_supplied: Same source-informed isolation site finder, radiation instrument, minimum of 32 measurements, navigation, parser, and finite expression grammar as previous baselines. Only invocation time depends on task feedback.

failure_witness.observation: Calibration refitting returned exactly the already-falsified target prediction. This baseline uses failure to trigger calibration but does not retain it as a model-selection constraint. It is not evidence that feedback-consistent model elimination would also fail.

review.assessment: The response does not specify distinct branch construction or operational parameter-to-mechanism assignment. Identical copies trained on identical data by identical deterministic updates do not create competing hypotheses. No native implementation or benefit is established by this proposal.

headline_cn: 新增24条原生任务轨迹中，固定校准为8/8，按需校准为7/8；后者动作更少，但未保持相同可靠性。
report_note_cn: 在Normal/Challenge、种子23/24的四个新世界中，首轮固定校准与实际失败后再校准均完成4/4任务，动作分别为1014和722。独立噪声复跑后，固定校准仍为4/4，按需校准降为3/4。两轮累计固定校准8/8、2028动作；按需校准7/8、1428动作；原始读数拟合4/8、716动作。不能把减少约29.6%的动作数解释为相同成功率下的效率提升。失败轨迹中，一个参考最小读数从另一次运行的10.08变为10.09，重拟合选回了已经实际失败的2921Hz预测。该结果支持加入保留任务反证的普通模型消除基线，尚不支持新学习机制或扩大实验。
decision: Keep the two calibration policies as executable comparators, not a novel contribution. Do not scale the finite template family or advertise a reliability-preserving speedup. Any new method must also be compared with ordinary feedback-consistent hypothesis elimination, and must introduce and test a distinct operation across core tasks.
